messages:
maya_s: Hey team — Corvex procurement replied. They will not accept any invoice until we have an official PO. They also require the signed SOW and a Certificate of Insurance (COI) attached, plus their VAT number printed on the invoice. They asked if we can issue a pro-forma so they can raise the PO. :thinking:

samir: We can produce a pro-forma PDF as a courtesy, but finance will not finalize an official tax invoice without a PO#. Pro-forma won't work for revenue recognition. :money_with_wings:

maya_s: Procurement explicitly said 'no pro-forma' in their email — policy is PO first. They pasted their PO template and it includes fields for company reg no. and VAT. They've also provided a contact: sarah.ng@corvex.com

samir: Understood. Quick next steps from billing side:
1) We can send a clearly labelled PRO-FORMA for their internal PO process (non-billable).
2) Final invoice generation requires the PO# and COI/SOW attached.
3) If the PO has a different billing address or currency, finance needs those exact details to produce a tax-compliant invoice.

alex.k: I'm on outreach to procurement. Maya — can you drop the PO template link here and I'll send our pro-forma + a short note to Sarah? I'll ask them to include the PO# and VAT on the document so finance can proceed immediately when it arrives.

maya_s: PO template: https://files.internal/corvex_po_template.pdf 
(They also uploaded a COI to the shared drive.)

samir: Pro-forma snippet you can paste into the email if helpful:
```
PRO-FORMA (For procurement/PO creation only)
Redwood Inference
Bill To: Corvex Technologies Ltd
Amount: $12,000 USD
Description: Reserved dedicated capacity — monthly commitment
Note: This is a pro-forma for PO creation and is not a final invoice. Final invoice will be issued upon receipt of an official PO#. Contact: billing@redwood.com
```

tina_ops: Legal reminder — include a link to our standard T&Cs on the pro-forma and a project code so procurement can reference it. Also confirm COI meets their minimum limits before sending.

maya_s: They said COI looks ok but procurement will only process once SOW is signed + PO submitted. They rejected placeholder PO#s.

billing-bot: Invoice Hold created — ticket BILL-2035-789. Reason: awaiting PO# and COI/SOW. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-2035-789

alex.k: I'll request the PO from Sarah now and push for expedited handling. If we don't have a PO by EOD Friday I'll escalate to @liz.sales. Will post any replies here.

samir: Finance note: when PO arrives ensure it contains exact billing address and VAT/Tax ID. If the PO lists a different currency, include that so we can route FX approval. Also attach the signed SOW and COI to the billing ticket to avoid delays.

maya_s: Got it — chasing procurement and uploading their COI to the ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
